content.title: What Our Students Say
content.description: Hear from graduates and current students about their St. Austin experience

items.name: Student Name 1
items.content: St. Austin's program gave me the practical skills and confidence I needed for my current role. The faculty truly cares about student success.

items.name: Student Name 2
items.content: The online flexibility allowed me to work full-time while earning my degree. The instructors are experts in their field with real-world experience.

items.name: Student Name 3
items.content: I appreciated the career services support. They helped me secure a role at a major tech company. The curriculum aligned perfectly with industry needs.

items.name: Student Name 4
items.content: The networking opportunities and peer collaboration transformed my career trajectory. Highly recommend St. Austin to anyone serious about growth.
